statement.p: Calculate the flux integral \int_S(4\vec i+4\vec j+4\vec k)\cdot d\vec A where S is a disk of radius 2 in the plane x+y+z=1, oriented upward.

static.solution: 4\vec i+4\vec j +4\vec k is perpendicular to S and in the same direction as the orientation, and since ||4\vec i +4\vec j+4\vec k||=\sqrt{4^2+4^2+4^2}=\sqrt{48} on S, we have \int_S(4\vec i+4\vec j +4\vec k)\cdot d\vec A =\sqrt{48}\cdot\hbox{Area of circle }=\sqrt{48}\cdot\pi 2^2 =4\pi\sqrt{48}.
